PrivateUser.title: PrivateUser
PrivateUser.description: Private user account metadata including PII isolated strictly to the account owner.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID

pathnerId.description: Unique human-friendly Pathner ID handle (3..32 lowercase alphanumeric/underscore/dash, optional)

photoData.description: Compressed Base64 custom avatar stored in Firestore (optional)

discoverable.description: Whether user appears in public contacts directory

hiddenChatIds.description: Chat room IDs deleted/hidden by this user (optional)

hiddenCallIds.description: Call log IDs deleted/hidden by this user (optional)

hiddenContactUids.description: Contact user UIDs deleted/hidden from this user's contacts list (optional)

PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile
PublicProfile.description: Public discoverable profile without PII for finding contacts and starting chats/calls.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID

pathnerId.description: Unique human-friendly Pathner ID handle (3..32 lowercase alphanumeric/underscore/dash, optional)

photoData.description: Compressed Base64 custom avatar stored in Firestore (optional)

discoverable.description: Opt-in flag for public contact discovery

PathnerIdReservation.title: PathnerIdReservation
PathnerIdReservation.description: Unique Pathner ID handle mapping to a Firebase Auth UID with zero PII.

pathnerId.description: Normalized unique Pathner ID matching document ID

ChatRoom.title: ChatRoom
ChatRoom.description: Direct, saved-notes, or group conversation room.

groupChat.description: True if group chat, false for direct/self chat

participantNames.description: Map of UID to display name

participantPhotos.description: Map of UID to avatar URL

lastMessageText.description: Preview text of most recent message

lastMessageDeliveredAt.description: Server timestamp when latest message was delivered to a peer (optional)

lastMessageReadAt.description: Server timestamp when latest message was read by a peer (optional)

typingUsers.description: Map of participant UID to last typing server timestamp (optional)

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Single message inside a chat supporting text, images, videos, files, and call events.

participantUids.description: Denormalized participant UIDs matching parent chat

mediaUrl.description: Firebase Storage HTTPS download URL for uploaded media (optional)

mediaData.description: Base64 synced image or small attachment payload fallback (optional)

localFilePath.description: Sender local cached file path hint (optional)

sentAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent and acknowledged by Firestore (optional)

deliveredToUids.description: List of participant UIDs whose device received this message (optional)

deliveredAt.description: Server timestamp when message was first delivered to a peer (optional)

readByUids.description: List of participant UIDs who read this message

readAt.description: Server timestamp when message was read by a peer (optional)

forwarded.description: True when message was forwarded from another chat (optional)

hiddenForUids.description: List of participant UIDs who deleted this message only for themselves (optional)

CallSession.title: CallSession
CallSession.description: Real-time video or voice call signaling record and call history entry.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated private user settings and email PII.

/public_profiles/{userId}.description: Public discoverable profiles with zero PII for contact lookup.

/pathner_ids/{pathnerId}.description: Unique Pathner ID handle directory mapping normalized IDs to owner UIDs.

/chats/{chatId}.description: Direct and group chat rooms scoped to participantUids.

/chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Messages belonging to a chat room with denormalized participantUids.

/calls/{callId}.description: Video and voice call signaling sessions and call log entries.
